finding: GET name does not imply read-only. Generic GETQUOTA is write-class because dquot acquisition may allocate or update quota storage.

source_paths.interpretation: GETFMT/GETINFO are non-write-class. Project GETQUOTA without CAP_SYS_ADMIN is rejected before get_dqblk dispatch.
Inactive quota ESRCH returns before acquiring the dquot/on-disk quota record; successful acquisition can allocate quota storage.

quota_dquot_allocation_assessment: Excluded on the observed inactive/permission failure paths under matching-release source semantics; not established by interpreting failed buffers.
